# Power numbers (generated by docs/hardware/power_calc.py)

Status: tested in simulation. 40 walking runs of 20 s on the ASMR robot with the F3 parts, case 7, 0 falls. F3 has no water system on the robot and is 1.4 kg lighter, so these walking powers are an upper estimate for F3.

## Motor bus (24 V, two 6S packs through the diode)

- Battery power, walking, mean of the runs: 48 W (highest run 54 W). Standing: 29 W. Both include 18 W drive standby (ASSUMED).
- Peak bus power: 411 W instant, 280 W over 20 ms. Peak into one drive: 163 W.
- Peak regen of the 12 drives together: 30 W. Peak regen of one drive: 61 W (2.5 A at 24 V). Mean regen power: at most 1.2 W in one run.
- The pump is on the water trolley (F3). The motor packs feed only the 12 drives.
- Battery time, two 6S at 80 % usable, simulated walking power: 3.7 h.

| Brake option | Peak bus voltage (V) | Peak resistor power (W) | Largest energy per event (J) | Mean resistor power, worst run (W) | Events per second | Brake current limit per drive (A) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 29.65 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.0 | - |
| 1 x 2.2 ohm | 25.54 | 30 | 0.69 | 0.95 | 5.3 | 11.2 |
| 2 x 2.2 ohm | 25.52 | 30 | 0.69 | 0.96 | 5.3 | 11.2 |
| 1 x 4.7 ohm | 25.59 | 30 | 0.69 | 0.94 | 5.3 | 5.2 |
| 2 x 4.7 ohm | 25.54 | 30 | 0.69 | 0.95 | 5.3 | 5.2 |
| 12 x own resistor, no ramp | 25.20 | 61 | - | 9.55 | 0.0 | - |

Ramp 25.5 V to 25.9 V, bus capacitance 6 mF, start at 25.2 V. The brake current counts in dc_max_positive_current (12 A).

## 3S rail (computer, relay coils, pan-tilt)

| Rail | Load | Typical (A) | Peak (A) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5V | ROCK 3C at full CPU load | 1.20 | 2.00 | estimate 5-6 W (parts.md). Radxa asks for a 5 V 3 A supply |
| 5V | 2 x CANable V2.0 Pro (isolated) | 0.20 | 0.25 | ASSUMED 100 mA each (isolated DC-DC + STM32G431) |
| 5V | Camera B0201 | 0.20 | 0.30 | listing: 300 mA max |
| 5V | IMU IM10A on UART | 0.01 | 0.02 | listing: 12 mA |
| 5V | Bus servo adapter, USB side | 0.02 | 0.05 | ASSUMED |
| 12V | Pan-tilt: 2 x ST3215 | 0.30 | 5.40 | Waveshare: stall 2.7 A each at 12 V. Typical ASSUMED |
| 12V | Push-lock switch lamps, meters | 0.05 | 0.05 | ASSUMED 15-20 mA each |

- 5 V rail: 1.63 A typical, 2.62 A peak.
- 3S input: 20.3 W typical (1.83 A at 11.1 V), 82.4 W peak (7.8 A at 10.5 V).
- 3S battery time at the typical load: 2.6 h.

## Water trolley (6S 1300 mAh pack BT4)

- Pack 28.9 Wh, 80 % usable.
- Spraying: pump (KLP02) 12 W or less (0.5 A at 24 V, datasheet), DMC-101 efficiency 90 % (ASSUMED), plus 1 W standby (ASSUMED): 14.3 W.
- Continuous spray: 1.6 h, which is 20 fills of the 2 L bag (4.8 min each).
- Mission with 10 % spray time (ASSUMED): 2.3 W on average, 9.9 h.

## Harness check

All rows pass.
